KXIRANWTICOMBO-28JAN.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Iran deal: Agreed, WTI: $60 to $74.99, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXIRANWTICOMBO-28JAN.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Iran deal is “Agreed” if the “Before Jan 1, 2028” market of the US-Iran nuclear deal event resolves to Yes and “Not agreed” if it resolves to No, using that event’s definition of a new Iran-US nuclear deal and its clarifications. WTI refers to the settlement price of WTI Crude Oil on Dec 31, 2027 at 2:30 PM ET, based on the February 2028 contract released on Dec 31, 2027.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Iran deal (AGREEMENT), WTI (WTIDIR). A component is satisfied when its outcome matches the stated condition, so Iran deal: Not agreed is satisfied if AGREEMENT resolves to No, and the contract resolves to No as soon as a qualifying deal occurs. All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, “$60 to $74.99” includes both $60.00 and $74.99, “$90 or above” includes $90.00, and “Below $60” means below $60.00.

KXHORMUZGASCOMBO-27AUG.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Hormuz traffic: Back to normal, Gas price: $3.40 to $3.79, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXHORMUZGASCOMBO-27AUG.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Hormuz traffic is “Back to normal” if the 7-day moving average of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 60 at any time before Jul 1, 2027, and “Not back to normal” if it is not, and Gas price refers to the AAA national average price for regular gasoline on Jul 31, 2027.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Hormuz traffic (POLITICALSTAT), Gas price (AAAGAS). Revisions published after expiration will not be considered. Each price range runs from its lower bound up to, but not including, the next range's lower bound. For example, “$3.40 to $3.79” covers $3.40 up to but not including $3.80, “$4.20 or above” includes $4.20, and “Below $3.40” covers prices less than $3.40.

KXINXPARTYCOMBO-30JAN.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Party: Democratic, S&P 500 change: 0% to 10%, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXINXPARTYCOMBO-30JAN.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Party refers to the political party of the person inaugurated as President for the term beginning Jan 20, 2029, and S&P 500 change refers to the percent change in the S&P 500 index from its closing value on Jan 19, 2029 to its closing value on Dec 31, 2029.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Party (PRESPARTY), S&P 500 change (INX). Revisions published after expiration will not be considered. The percent change is not rounded. Each band includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound. For example, “0% to 10%” includes 0% and excludes 10%, “10% to 20%” includes 10%, and “20% or above” includes 20%. For the S&P 500 change component, these bands apply in place of the INX "between" range, which would include both endpoints, so a change exactly equal to a band's upper bound falls only in the next band. If neither a Democratic nor a Republican candidate is inaugurated as President, every market resolves to No.

KXCPIPARTYCOMBO-30MAR.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Party: Democratic, CPI inflation: 2.0% to 2.9%, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXCPIPARTYCOMBO-30MAR.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Party refers to the political party of the person inaugurated as President for the term beginning Jan 20, 2029, and CPI inflation refers to the 12-month percent change in the all items Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), before seasonal adjustment, for December 2029, as first published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics to one decimal place in its December 2029 CPI release.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Party (PRESPARTY), CPI inflation (YOYCPI). Revisions published after expiration will not be considered. All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, “2.0% to 2.9%” includes both 2.0% and 2.9%, “4.0% or above” includes 4.0%, and “1.9% or below” includes 1.9%. If neither a Democratic nor a Republican candidate is inaugurated as President, every market resolves to No. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown

KXGDPPARTYCOMBO-30MAR.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Party: Democratic, GDP growth: 0.1% to 1.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXGDPPARTYCOMBO-30MAR.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Party refers to the political party of the person inaugurated as President for the term beginning Jan 20, 2029, and GDP growth refers to the first-published annual percent change in real gross domestic product (GDP) for 2029 in the Bureau of Economic Analysis's advance estimate, expected with the advance estimate of Q4 2029 GDP in early 2030.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Party (PRESPARTY), GDP growth (GDPYEAR). Revisions published after expiration will not be considered. All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, "2.1% to 2.5%" includes both 2.1% and 2.5%, "3.1% or above" includes 3.1%, and "0.0% or below" includes 0.0%. If neither a Democratic nor a Republican candidate is inaugurated as President, every market resolves to No.

KXLEPENEURCOMBO-27JUN.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: French president: Marine Le Pen, EUR/USD change: 3% or above, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXLEPENEURCOMBO-27JUN.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, French president refers to the person first elected President of France in the 2027 presidential election, and EUR/USD change refers to the percent change in the Pyth Network FX.EUR/USD price from the start time to the end time. "Not Marine Le Pen" means that a person other than Marine Le Pen is elected.

The start time is 4:00 PM ET on the last Friday before the first round of the election. The end time is 10:00 AM ET on the first Monday after the second round, or after the first round if a candidate is elected in it. If the first round is held on Apr 18, 2027 and the second round on May 2, 2027, the start time is Apr 16, 2027 at 4:00 PM ET and the end time is May 3, 2027 at 10:00 AM ET. The percent change is (end price - start price) / start price x 100, using each Pyth price rounded to four decimal places, and is not rounded further. Each range includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound. For example, "-3% to -1%" includes -3% but not -1%, and "3% or above" includes 3%.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: French president (FRENCHPRES), EUR/USD change (FXEURUSD). The Pyth price refers to the aggregate price only, and no averaging or carry-forward of stale prices applies. Revisions published after expiration will not be considered. If no President has been elected or the end time has not occurred before this market closes, every market resolves to No.

KXFEDCOMBO-26DEC.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur for Dec 2026: Federal Funds Rate Decision: No change, Dissents: 0, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFEDCOMBO-26DEC.rules_secondary: This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Federal Funds Rate Decision uses FEDDECISION, Dissents uses FOMCDISSENTCOUNT. For economic data releases, resolution uses the first officially released value (not preliminary or revised estimates unless specified). All conditions must be satisfied within the specified time period.

KXPAYROLLSPARTYCOMBO-30SEP.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Party: Democratic, Jobs added in 2029: 500,000 to 1 million, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXPAYROLLSPARTYCOMBO-30SEP.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Party refers to the political party of the person inaugurated as President for the term beginning Jan 20, 2029, and Jobs added in 2029 refers to the change in seasonally adjusted total nonfarm payroll employment from December 2028 to December 2029, as first published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, normally in its December 2029 Employment Situation report. The change is the December 2029 level minus the December 2028 level in the seasonally adjusted Total nonfarm row of Table B-1 of the report that first publishes a December 2029 level. Later revisions, including the annual benchmark revision published with the January 2030 report, are excluded.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Party (PRESPARTY), Jobs added in 2029 (PAYROLLS). Each band includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound. For example, “0 to 500,000” includes 0 and excludes 500,000, “500,000 to 1 million” includes 500,000, and “1.5 million or above” includes 1.5 million. For the Jobs added in 2029 component, these bands apply in place of the PAYROLLS "between" range, which would include both endpoints, so a change exactly equal to a band's upper bound falls only in the next band. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown, and a December 2029 Employment Situation report first published within that extension and before Sep 1, 2030 counts.

KXU3PARTYCOMBO-30SEP.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Party: Democratic, Unemployment rate: 4.1% to 4.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXU3PARTYCOMBO-30SEP.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Party refers to the political party of the person inaugurated as President for the term beginning Jan 20, 2029, and Unemployment rate refers to the seasonally adjusted U.S. unemployment rate (U-3) for December 2029, as first published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics to one decimal place in its December 2029 Employment Situation report.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Party (PRESPARTY), Unemployment rate (ECONSTATB). Later revisions will not affect the outcome. All stated bounds are inclusive. For example, “4.1% to 4.5%” includes both 4.1% and 4.5%, “5.1% or above” includes 5.1%, and “4.0% or below” includes 4.0%. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown, and a December 2029 Employment Situation report first published within that extension and before Sep 1, 2030 counts.
